name: 헨리

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 실험체 스킬: 시간 재구축 영역

visual_review: 보랏빛 회색 머리·가라앉은 눈·황금 시계바늘 무기와 코트를 유지했습니다. 바늘 올리기·양팔 펼치기·영역 조작·폭발 마무리의 팔/몸 자세가 변합니다.
motion_summary: Henry short asymmetrical muted lavender/silver hair, narrow serious eyes, purple-black coat with gold clock-hand weapons from portrait. Official R spreads a temporal field around himself, slows incoming projectiles and explodes as it expires. Animate idle; raising one golden clock hand; fingers rotating a small clock dial; planting feet and opening both arms; cyan-gold transparent circular clocklike field expands low around him; sweeping arm clockwise; stepping torso with second sweep as clock spokes turn; two tiny static projectile streaks slow near field edge; arms sharply close inward; field collapses into sharp gold-cyan burst right of body; coat and arms settle; original idle. No numerals, no real clock text. Actual arm, torso and foot changes, face visible above ring.
